key_insight: AMPEL is an open-source platform designed to build hospital-wide clinical decision support systems while supporting EU Medical Device Regulation requirements.
clinical_relevance: The platform aims to deliver traceable, explainable alerts and analysis results to medical staff without disrupting established care workflows.
method: Uses Kafka-based, event-driven distributed architecture to process incoming medical data.
Defines platform events with Protocol Buffers to connect independently developed algorithms across programming languages.
Provides a basic user interface and alert functionality for presenting results.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes implementation through LAMPE at University of Leipzig Medical Center but reports no quantitative performance or patient-outcome evaluation.
watch_item: Platform adoption alone does not establish regulatory compliance or clinical benefit; deployment requires local validation and risk management.
paper_title: The AMPEL Platform: An Open-Source Project for Developing Hospital-Wide Clinical Decision Support Systems under EU-Regulation
